title: uuencoding-multi: remove unicode-case and unicode-perl from regex features
description: All regex patterns in subject.rs and toc.rs match only ASCII characters. unicode-case (for non-ASCII case-folding like ß→ss) and unicode-perl (for Unicode \w/\b/\d) are never exercised. Remove both from Cargo.toml features list to reduce compile time and binary size. Verify behavior unchanged with cargo test after removal.
